body.source:
id: parity_child
namespace: exomachina.kestra_parity
description: Visible two-branch reference using only native core task types; Quality and release are placeholders.
inputs:
  - id: outcome
    type: STRING
    defaults: repair_success
tasks:
  - id: evidence_parallel
    type: io.kestra.plugin.core.flow.Parallel
    concurrent: 2
    tasks:
      - id: source
        type: io.kestra.plugin.core.debug.Return
        format: source_evidence@1:source-a
      - id: counter
        type: io.kestra.plugin.core.debug.Return
        format: counter_evidence@1:objection-a
  - id: join
    type: io.kestra.plugin.core.debug.Return
    format: "{{ outputs.source.value }}|{{ outputs.counter.value }}"
  - id: synthesize_r1
    type: io.kestra.plugin.core.debug.Return
    format: "candidate-r1:{{ outputs.join.value }}"
  - id: quality_r1
    type: io.kestra.plugin.core.debug.Return
    description: Deterministic placeholder, not independent Quality or identity verification.
    format: REJECT
  - id: repair_route
    type: io.kestra.plugin.core.flow.Switch
    value: "{{ inputs.outcome }}"
    cases:
      repair_success:
        - id: repair_r2
          type: io.kestra.plugin.core.debug.Return
          format: candidate-r2-addressed
        - id: quality_r2_positive
          type: io.kestra.plugin.core.debug.Return
          format: ACCEPT
        - id: acceptance_r2
          type: io.kestra.plugin.core.debug.Return
          description: Placeholder, not an authoritative product acceptance.
          format: accepted-r2
        - id: release_r2
          type: io.kestra.plugin.core.debug.Return
          description: Placeholder, no external release effect.
          format: receipt-r2
      exhausted:
        - id: repair_r2_unresolved
          type: io.kestra.plugin.core.debug.Return
          format: candidate-r2-unresolved
        - id: quality_r2_negative
          type: io.kestra.plugin.core.debug.Return
          format: REJECT
        - id: repair_r3_unresolved
          type: io.kestra.plugin.core.debug.Return
          format: candidate-r3-unresolved
        - id: quality_r3_negative
          type: io.kestra.plugin.core.debug.Return
          format: REJECT
        - id: director_wait
          type: io.kestra.plugin.core.flow.Pause
          onResume:
            - id: abort
              type: BOOL
              defaults: false
        - id: abort_result
          type: io.kestra.plugin.core.debug.Return
          description: Placeholder; native SUCCESS here is not an authoritative aborted factory result.
          format: aborted
    defaults:
      - id: invalid_outcome
        type: io.kestra.plugin.core.execution.Fail
outputs:
  - id: public_result
    type: STRING
    value: "{{ inputs.outcome }}"
